shell.tagline: Lower-environment shell for switching among saved signed-JWT test users while exercising the shared NHSNLink UI.
shell.noSavedUsers: No test users have been saved yet. Answer "who are you simulating?" below.
shell.createProfileTitle: Create a lower-environment JWT test profile
shell.selectOrCreateDescription: The standalone shell only initializes NHSNLink after a signed-JWT test profile has been selected. Use the shell controls on the left to configure the test identity, issuer, key id, and private key used by the lower-environment harness to sign the bearer token.
shell.modeMockHint: In-memory fixtures. No backing services required.
shell.modeBffHint: Signs a real JWT from the active test user and calls the BFF.

state.selectOrCreateProfile: Select or create a test profile

home.maintenanceModeDescription: This framework foundation is in maintenance mode. As the facility configuration evolves, this area can surface the specific onboarding artifacts or settings that need to be reviewed or updated.
home.onboardingModeDescription: This framework foundation is in onboarding mode. Future work will guide the user through initial facility onboarding, source-system coordination, and role-appropriate setup tasks.
